Unified sample size calculator (three-axis API)

Source: R/calculate.R
calculate.Rd

Computes sample size (or events/cases) for a study design identified by the triple design / task / outcome. See docs/DESIGN_MATRIX.md (source repository) for the complete combination table, formulas, and literature sources.

Usage

calculate(...)

Arguments

...

Control and design arguments, resolved by EXACT name (partial matching is deliberately avoided so that design-specific arguments such as d cannot be swallowed by the design slot). Recognised control arguments: design (e.g. "rct", "caseControl", "diagAccuracy"; may be the first positional argument), task ("estimate", "test", "noninferiority", "superiority", "equivalence"; optional for unambiguous designs, may be the second positional argument), outcome ("mean", "proportion", "rate", "survival", "auc", "lr", "correlation", "ordinal", "events"; optional for unambiguous designs, may be the third positional argument), alpha (type I error, default 0.05), and power (target power, default 0.8). All remaining named arguments are design-specific parameters, identical to the names used by the legacy sample_size_calculator() API.

Value

Object of class sample_size_result with print, summary, and plot methods. New-style objects additionally carry axis metadata (task, outcome, design_canonical, results, roles, adjustments).

Examples

calculate("rct", "test", "mean", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results
#> • Design type: "Two independent samples, mean comparison"
#> • Sample size per group: 37
#> • Total sample size: 74
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
calculate(
  design = "rct", task = "noninferiority", outcome = "mean",
  mean1 = 10, mean2 = 9.5, sd = 3, margin = 1
)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results
#> • Design type: "Non-inferiority (means)"
#> • Sample size per group: 50
#> • Total sample size: 100
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
calculate("diagAUC", auc = 0.80, d = 0.05)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results
#> • Design type: "Single-group AUC CI precision"
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
